position: Friends without musical training can answer one another to make a recognisable place that remembers its real contributors. This iteration concentrates on completion, cause and authorship rather than more destinations.

implementation.presentation: Retained playable 3D; original planet/coastal room and coordinates unchanged. No new engine, schema, dependency or external asset.
implementation.authorship: Stable real-author colour and shape shared by source leaves and record. Only live cross-author answers add directed light; same-cookie tabs and NPCs cannot qualify. Six visible slots prioritise real answers; the record retains all sources.
implementation.consequences: Choice forecasts use all live ingredients, not just a guessed recipe. Removed endpoints retain provenance without live effects.
implementation.invitation: A public work reference survives joining and reopening. It grants no identity, permission, sound preference or automatic contribution.
implementation.placement: Private preview remains available when public placement is blocked. Safe great-circle path planning uses actual collision/privacy rules, explicit cancellation, current controller position and a separate Leave action. Full corners offer an explicit new-place action. No historical source is moved.
implementation.scopeTradeoff: The shared compositions and persistent source engine are refined; cafe, chat, private rooms, locomotion and old coast remain. Wider asset replacement and new minigames are deferred.

sourceSuite.runtime: Final tested compiled build matching application 5f1fc28; current source includes the two added actual-controller checks.

answerFlow.scope: Actual invitation URL through new joining; private decoded audition; same two-author canopy; withdrawal; different lantern answer; mute, phone touch, keyboard cancellation, identity and authored record after reload. Local scripted developer path, not an unprompted user study.

historicalPlacement.remotePeer: Separate authenticated cookie identity through HTTP; browser observer receives real SSE. Main answer flow separately covers two renderers.
historicalPlacement.scope: Actual historical parent selection, blocked private audition, honest no-space feedback, explicit Stage start, cancelled safe walk, chat focus, arrival without publishing, remote add/remove availability and explicit Leave. Cleanup retains every original planet/coastal source.

fullCreationRegression.scope: Before the final immediate-travel correction. Three real areas, musical entry, running/jumping, two identities/shared-cookie control, phone resizing, held ACK after missed SSE plus actual reconnect, withdrawal, late loading and original source preservation. Final immediate-travel and invitation paths have separate final-build checks.

processPersistence.scope: Independent cookie jars; duplicate delivery creates one source/event; reconnect, actual process replacement, all durable row equivalence, committed retry, removed-parent attribution, late reply rejection. Not a genuine next-day session.

verification.typecheck: tsc --noEmit passed; release tsc build passed.
verification.evidenceReferences: check-evidence passed: three historical reflections and eleven resolving PROCESS commit references. Does not validate personal beliefs or research interpretation.
verification.releaseBuild: Fresh release is byte-identical to all 63 files of the final browser-tested compilation.

promotedObserver.scope: Fresh unjoined actual 18861 observer, Sound off, nine existing live public sources and real author marks; all four whitelisted notes 200, unknown note 404, phone page and note table stay within viewport. Browser blocks every non-GET/HEAD request.

failuresAndNegativeControls.initialExperience: A real in-app-browser visit on a frozen historical backup privately listened to Soft pulse while answering nick, then received real too_close from Leave. The original preview was never a write-test target.

nativeJournalCloseBefore.result: One actual native-close handoff target failed before correction; fifteen other checks passed in that separate run.

fixtureAssumptions.description: Three failed attempts confused nine public planet sources with Green membership or assumed a new identity would choose the same parent as Alison. Counts and actual record selection were corrected; no data was reset to satisfy the fixture.

realTravelFailure.description: Immediate travel used the old animation position and disabled available choices. Finding the already-valid current point started a zero-length walk which closed without reopening. Real screenshot and failure retained; 5f1fc28 uses world.at and refreshes the existing choice without a walk.

legacyTestBudget.description: One full repeated run reached a legacy workflow overall 5-second timeout, after that workflow deliberately spent 4.56 seconds in rate/move waits before HTTP overhead. Overall budget became 10 seconds; every one-second SSE assertion stayed unchanged. Clean 275 and final 277 runs passed.

promotion.note: 29 sound rows were observed at task start; the actual stable promotion snapshot contains 31. Every row in that current snapshot, not an older backup, was retained.

rollback.rule: Use retained compiled application files with the current DB. Do not restore the earlier database for visual rollback.

developerVisualReview: Inspected unmodified actual desktop shared-canopy and phone choice captures. Source labels no longer stack over the two characters while the work panel is open; selected-source and record alternatives remain. First phone Listen/Leave fit and have at least 44-pixel targets. This is developer visual review, not an aesthetic preference or novice result.
